== Background ==
Got into the spotlight for using aimbot in dmm4 tournament and [[EQL]]. It was [[Valla]] who first spotted Ilf's weird crosshair movements on the map [[E1M2]] when he spectated an EQL game with Ilf playing. After the observations on this map, he kept track of Ilf on the second map to gather more convincing evidence. Admins were notified and a [http://www.quakeworld.nu/forum/viewtopic.php?id=128 thread on Quakeworld.nu] emerged where [[Sassa]] posted demos. People analysed them in slow-motion only to notice how the shaft at times snapped to the torso of the enemy players. Some people still claim that he was just naturally gifted whereas most of the scene was certain of bot usage.
